# 4 bed semi-detached house for sale

> Step into Limebrook, where modern living blends with a sense of natural calm. Just minutes from Navan and within easy reach of Dublin, Limebrook features a considered mix of modern family homes designed to meet the needs of first-time buyers, growing families and downsizers alike. Limebrook offers connection, convenience and a grounded sense of place where life can unfold at a balanced pace.
